HYPERONE_API_URL.title: HYPERONE_API_URL
HYPERONE_API_URL.description: Allows to pass custom API Endpoint to be used in the challenge (default https://api.hyperone.com/v2)

HYPERONE_LOCATION_ID.title: HYPERONE_LOCATION_ID
HYPERONE_LOCATION_ID.description: Specifies location (region) to be used in API calls. (default pl-waw-1)

HYPERONE_PASSPORT.title: HYPERONE_PASSPORT
HYPERONE_PASSPORT.description: Passport file contents (JSON), inline; alternative to HYPERONE_PASSPORT_LOCATION

HYPERONE_PASSPORT_LOCATION.title: HYPERONE_PASSPORT_LOCATION
HYPERONE_PASSPORT_LOCATION.description: Allows to pass custom passport file location (default ~/.h1/passport.json)

HYPERONE_POLLING_INTERVAL.title: HYPERONE_POLLING_INTERVAL
HYPERONE_POLLING_INTERVAL.description: Time between DNS propagation check in seconds (Default: 60)

HYPERONE_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.title: HYPERONE_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT
HYPERONE_PROPAGATION_TIMEOUT.description: Maximum waiting time for DNS propagation in seconds (Default: 2)

HYPERONE_TTL.title: HYPERONE_TTL
HYPERONE_TTL.description: The TTL of the TXT record used for the DNS challenge in seconds (Default: 120)
